purpose: Teach: 部首/肉食/賢者/胃腸/貧富/剰余/分娩/既知

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、漢字の部首分類を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered kanji radicals and their classification in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Straightforward delivery without rush. Eyes engaged on Sakura's face. The tone of a teacher who has read the work and wants to hear the student's own account.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、肉食動物の生態学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the ecology and behavior of carnivores.
lines.style: Clear and direct, meeting the teacher's gaze steadily. A slight lift at the start, confidence without performance. Neither defensive nor overly eager to please.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古代インドの賢者像を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You examined portrayals of wisdom figures in ancient Indian texts, if I remember correctly?
lines.style: Gentle prompt, slightly more thoughtful than the first. A small pause before the question, as if genuinely recalling. Patient, inviting elaboration without pressure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ストレス性胃腸障害を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I analyzed the relationship between stress and gastrointestinal disorders.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No apology in the tone. A quiet confidence in the subject matter. Brief but complete, the way someone answers when they know their work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の貧富格差を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you looked at economic inequality in modern society across your research?
lines.style: Engaged but measured. The question lands with genuine interest — not probing for a specific answer, but inviting Sakura to claim her own work. Warm beneath the professionalism.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、整数論の剰余類を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I explored modular arithmetic and residue classes in number theory.
lines.style: Calm and precise. The words carry the weight of the subject. No hedging, no softening. A student speaking about real work she has done.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 無痛分娩の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You researched the history of painless childbirth methods — that's quite a breadth of interest.
lines.style: Slightly more reflective, a touch of gentle curiosity. A soft smile audible in the tone. Not probing, but noticing the range. The recognition of a student whose mind moves across domains.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、既知のデータと新発見の比較を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I compared known data with new findings to draw my conclusions.
lines.style: Confident close. Slight lift on the opening. Eyes forward. The tone of someone finishing a thought clearly, without trailing or rushing. Ready for the next thing.
